posts.text: Today we’re mourning the loss of our dear colleague @repdavidscott. In his more than two decades in Congress, David was a fighter for farmers across the country and the people of Georgia's 13th Congressional District. May his memory be a blessing to our country.

On Earth Day, we celebrate our natural environment, including the beautiful public spaces in Maryland's Eighth District. Let’s recommit ourselves to protecting our dazzling natural resources so they can be enjoyed by future generations.

Hey @FBIDirectorKash, we’ve heard alarming reports about your alleged alcohol abuse on the job. Americans need to know, I'm sure you agree, that our FBI Director is well and fit to serve.

We've sent you this standard questionnaire used in the public and private sectors. Please complete and return it to @HouseJudiciary Democrats immediately.
My statement on MAGA’s bigoted Anti-Muslim Caucus:

Excellent news for the Eighth District! NeighborWorks of America will award $506,000 to Montgomery Housing Partnership. The grant will help house more of our neighbors, create economic opportunity and make our community stronger. Thank you NeighborWorks, thank you MHP!

Ahead of Earth Day, this week's Local Hero is David Blockstein, an ecologist and conservation biologist who leads Worldwide Climate and Justice Education Month. Dr. Blockstein promotes ecological education and action—locally, nationally and globally.

My message to President Trump and all who come after him: your job is to “Take care that the laws are faithfully executed,” and if you cannot do it, the Constitution has a way to deal with it.

Video

We have 535 Members of Congress but just one President. That's why we need a bipartisan independent commission under the 25th Amendment to make sure this president—and all future presidents—are fit to discharge the duties of their office.

Congress should pass H.R. 8275 to fill this constitutional void.

Secretary Hegseth thinks the First Amendment doesn't apply to him, but the Constitution covers the Pentagon, too. Gee, Pope Leo is a U.S. citizen with every bit as much right to speak about America as JD Vance has. That’s the First Amendment—the same one protecting convicted felon Donald Trump’s blasphemous impersonation of Jesus Christ and attacks on the Pope as “soft on crime.” The Pope has a much larger audience for his views in America (or Hungary!) than JD Vance.

To Sikh Americans in MD-08 and all those celebrating around the world: happy Vaisakhi. May you rejoice during this harvest festival with family and friends.

On Yom HaShoah, we remember the six million Jews and millions of others massacred by the Nazis. May the memories of the perished be a blessing and constant spur to us as the world organizes to fight resurgent fascism, antisemitism and hate.

Stephen Miller exists now to turn America into a fascist Gangster State that uses the federal government as a weapon of control and violence against the people. But the people, from Maryland to Minnesota to Miller’s California, are rising up, like the people of Hungary, against all the corruption. Authoritarians are sinking all over the world.


Stephen Miller (@StephenM)

The Democrat Party exists now to make America into a third world country. It is the mass looting of a civilization.
